newsitem.headline: TABLE - Fair, Isaac and Co Q3 results.

text.p: (dollars in thousands, except per share amounts)
9 mos ended 9 mos ended 3 mos ended 3 mos ended
Results for the quarter ended June 30, 1997 include substantially all of the company's expenses in connection with its acquisition of Risk Management Technologies.

These expenses reduced earnings by approximately $.04 per share. Although the transaction closed as between the parties on June 23, certain formalities involving the State of California could not be completed until after July 1. Accordingly, the merger was not formally completed during the June quarter, and thus RMT's results for the periods ending June 30 have not been included in the company's financial statements. The acquisition of RMT will be accounted for as a pooling of interests.

If RMT had been consolidated, net income for the quarter ended June 30, 1997, would have been approximately $4.29 million ($.30 per share) on revenues of $51.1 million, compared with net income of $4.50 million ($.32 per share) on revenues of $38.8 million for the quarter ended June 30, 1996. For the first nine months of fiscal 1997, combined net income would have been about $14.36 million ($1.00 per share) on revenues of $142.8 million, compared with net income of $12.57 million ($0.90 per share) on revenues of $109.5 million for the corresponding period of 1996.
